simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַשְׁמָן (H820) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אַשְׁמָן (ʼashmân) means a fat field First listed occurrence: Isa 59 10.

definitions.full: H820. ashmannim אַשְׁמַנִּים (elative, Ges §§ 85b , 133a; on נּ see Id. §§ 20a , 93ee) apparently noun [masculine] plural ׳בָּא כַּמֵּתִים Isa 59:10 perhaps: (we are) among the stout (RV lusty ) like dead men , compare Di-Kit; or abstract in (actual) vigour (Buhl) > AV (after JosKi from אָשַׁם Hosea 14:1 'be desolate' ') in desolate places (other conjectures see (Che Hpt Marti).
